AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLE_CHAOS_RELICS.ho: When off: chaos relics stop generating, the reward pool returns to vanilla relics, owned chaos relics have no effect.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLE_EXTRA_POOL.hove: Extra pool adds non-vanilla-relic effects: hand retain/sly/ethereal, enchantments (sharp/nimble/imbued), retain triggers, watcher stances (requires the Watcher mod). Off by default; when on, these templates join the generation pool. Both MP ends must match.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_MULTIPLIER: Does not affect generation since the v0.5 point-budget system (kept for save compatibility).
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_BUDGET_COM: Point budget for Common chaos relics. Positive entries cost points; negative entries refund points. Default 10.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_BUDGET_UNC: Point budget for Uncommon chaos relics. Default 16.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_BUDGET_RAR: Point budget for Rare chaos relics. Default 24.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_NEGATIVE_C: Percent chance a Common chaos relic carries one negative entry. Default 35.
Percent chance an Uncommon chaos relic carries one negative entry. Default 55.
Percent chance a Rare chaos relic carries one negative entry. Default 75.
